evidence.evidence_text: We propose QUIDS, a method that leverages dual-space contrastive learning to isolate intent-relevant information while suppressing irrelevant content.
QUIDS combines a dual-encoder representation space with a disentangling decoder that works together to produce concise and accurate intent descriptions.
QUIDS combines a dual-encoder representation space with a disentangling decoder that works together to produce concise and accurate intent descriptions.
Enhanced by intent-driven hard negative sampling, the model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across ROUGE, BERTScore, and human/LLM evaluations.
